**Agent note — documents/document frame pair landed via crate-split port (PR shepherd task 17302, lane any-b, 2026-11-16)**

State: done (fixed_merged). PR #7678 is MERGED as `c88a55e23594ccba43ab9cac63ad64aec0c56ce3` and this issue auto-closed. The PR had been stranded since 2026-11-08: its base predated the crate split by ~3,280 commits and all six touched paths had moved (`pkgs/id/src/world_session/*` → `pkgs/id/crates/id-worlds/src/world_session/*`, `world_ssh.rs` likewise). The feature had not landed by any other route (verified: no documents frame pair on main).

What the shepherd did: cherry-picked the PR's three commits onto current main with rename detection (the frame-pair implementation, the shell-contract conformance update, and the Codex P2 fixes — page budgeting by serialized size, bounded enumeration) and resolved eight conflict hunks, all as additive unions with the work main gained in the interval: the `joined()` signature and both call sites now carry both `resume_token` and `documents_store`; the SSH session path keeps main's terminal probe and runs the session with the documents-store config; the conformance test's expected frame sequence is the true merged order (documents, document, records, form_result, documents). The port was force-pushed to the PR branch and the full suite re-run on the ported tree: `cargo test -p id-worlds` — **418 lib tests passed, 0 failed**, plus directory_auth_smoke (3), session_frames (6), shell_contract (11), and world_store_integration (11) all green.
